name: vaner-codex
description: Vaner predictive context for Codex: MCP tools, feedback skill, and lifecycle hooks for local prompt-intent learning.

interface.longDescription: Vaner prepares likely next context for Codex using local repository evidence and local prompt/session signals. Prompt text is redacted before it is stored locally and is not sent to cloud services by this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Ask vaner.suggest what, if anything, Vaner should contribute
Adopt at most one strong matching prepared context package
Answer normally when Vaner has nothing clearly relevant
